name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A small card of more about a link (a person's profile, a page's summary) that opens after a pause on hover or keyboard focus, and stays while the pointer moves onto it.

meta.when: A preview that sighted pointer users can do without: the link itself must lead to the same content, because touch screens and screen readers do not get the card. For a few words use tooltip; for content people act on use popover.
meta.example: Ada Designer on the maps team since 2024.
